items.title: Edward "Kid" Ory Interview, 1957-04-20
items.q: I followed Robichaux in there... Then after, and I'd taken all Robichaux away... He'd say, I'd like you to work with me. I said, thank you, Mr. Robichaux, I'm doing all right.

ctx.x: It could apply to either sex. And they kept calling him kid because, after all, he was young and sweet looking to them.

He still is. Still is. In a way. And so that's why I got the name kid. Now, if you understand about Bartlett, Bartlett Bowling. Yeah. Brother, Bartlett Bowling. Yeah, dark red. Robichoux used to play before I started playing there, you know. You can't play all the way back. And he.
